ask: Amend git-integration-branch-merge in place (CLAUDE.md line 56 at 73ed71a), no new rule. (1) Today: 'Never push to a ready PR while its CI runs.' New: 'Never push to a ready PR while its CI run can still go green. Once a job is red, push the lane drop or the lane fix at once; the push cancels the old run, and the new run is the re-run.' (2) Today a red lane is always dropped and fixed in its own lane for the next batch. Add: a red check is instead fixed in its lane and the lane re-merged, when all hold: the fix is a few lines in the failing lane's own files; the failing check is about form (record format, version bump, lint), not a behaviour test; it is the lane's first such fix in this batch (a second red drops it); and the fix goes on the lane branch, never in the batch branch. A lane red on a behaviour test is dropped as today, with any lane that depends on it. Reason lines: a red run cannot merge, so waiting only delays the re-run; dropping a chain of lanes for a one-line form fix costs a batch cycle for nothing (owner, Oct 21). No guard. Update the rule's row in docs/records.md if it quotes the clause. Small, fits the rule-text batch (c10, c26, c28, c20).
note: Done: landed in #560, merged Oct 22. Your rulings, Oct 21: (1) the rule needs correcting, not the session (batch #552's first run: a red Mod version bump check on lane #549 while the old head's macOS job still ran; the red gates job had skipped 30 later steps anyway). (2) Your gripe, same day: #552's second run went red on the Ruling kind check (decision shell-scripts-check-out-lf in lane #554 had Kind: build but no Plan: line); #558's line-ending test needs #554's rule and #557 is merged into #554, so the drop rule would have dropped three lanes for a one-line fix. Your ruling, Oct 21: agreed, the in-lane fix exception as written in the Ask. Advice sent: fix the line on #554's branch, re-merge, push at once; and ask why local checks missed it before the lane joined. The advisor's first answer on (1), keep the rule and add a guard, is withdrawn.
title: A red batch run gets its fix or drop pushed at once
why: Your gripe, Oct 21: a session pushed a lane drop to the ready batch PR while a job of its red run was still going, against the rule, and reported it as a deviation.
